notes.tool: tools/deploy-pontes/vault_pontes.py (validate / args / verify); the owner deploys with forge, never an agent. HELD: validate, args and verify refuse this config without --rehearsal while the route's launch records say held (tools/signatario-stable/native_ether.py)
notes.sequence: docs/BRIDGE-ETH.md section 6 (as docs/BUSDC-MAINNET-V2.md section 4, with this vault contract)
notes.units: 1 ETH = 1e6 units; one unit = 1e12 wei (NativeEtherSourceVault.UNIT). Every amount below is in units
notes.token: the native-ether marker 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE: the vault holds ether itself; its constructor refuses any other value
notes.cap: 280 ETH = the L2 supplyCap (beth-token.config.json, validated). Sized from the USD rule of 2026-11-19 (500,000 USD) at 1,777 USD per ETH; immutable, so its USD value floats with the price (995,120 USD at twice the price)
notes.windowLimit: 28 ETH per 24 h = the L2 token bucket (50,000 USD at 1,777 USD per ETH): the release token bucket, the largest single deposit and the largest single burn
notes.switchThreshold: 6 of 7, as on the USDC vault (owner decision 2026-11-02)
notes.switchDelay: 14 days, as on the USDC vault
notes.guard: three independent pause-only guardians, 72 h pause and cooldown, as on the USDC vault
notes.minDeposit: 7.004 ETH: with the 5 bps deposit fee (rounded up) it nets 7.000498 ETH, at or above l2MinBurn 7 ETH. l2MinBurn 7 ETH is the least round amount whose 10 bps release fee (0.007 ETH) pays the relayer's worst-case release, 227,000 gas, at the 30 gwei ceiling (floor 6.81 ETH; tools/signatario-stable/native_ether.py numbers). OWNER INPUT: the floor is 0.454 ETH at a 2 gwei ceiling (the USDC route's) and 2.27 ETH at 10 gwei
notes.provenance: mode 1 (mint chain), releaseDelay 0, no mintVerifier: the launch design of the USDC vault
notes.fees: 5 bps of each deposit and 10 bps of each release (the Ethereum schedule, coordinator 2026-11-19), each rounded UP to the unit, to the owner's fee address, in ether
notes.TBD-owner: source.revision; deployer.address (fresh key, nonce 0); deployer.fundedBy.safe; 7 release signer operators + Ethereum addresses; 3 guardian operators + Ethereum addresses
